about.title: About OpenProvena
about.subtitle: Discover our mission, our principles and how we evaluate information credibility.
about.problem_p1: Today, you can easily check whether an Internet connection is secure. But when reading an article, an AI-generated answer or a social media post, it is often very difficult to quickly know:
about.problem_p2: We have tools to secure communications.
about.problem_p3: Far fewer to assess the trustworthiness of information itself.
about.solution_p1: OpenProvena was born from this reflection.
about.solution_p2: The idea is to build an open standard that allows associating with information:
about.principles_quote: The goal is not to decide what is true or false. The goal is to give everyone the necessary elements to form their own judgment.
about.feature_analyze_text: Enter a URL or domain to get a detailed credibility analysis
about.feature_signals_text: 50+ signals analyzed: domain age, citation quality, transparency, etc.
about.feature_transparency_text: Every score is explained with the evidence supporting it
about.opensource_text: OpenProvena is a community project. All the code is available, algorithms are transparent and documented.
about.contribute_text: Want to take part in the project? Discover how to contribute on GitHub.
